title: Human-AI Orchestration Evaluation Framework
description: Framework for evaluating systems where humans direct AI agents rather than performing tasks directly. Based on Phil Schroeder's insight that we're shifting from user-flows to AI-orchestration flows.

thought_leader.name: Phil Schroeder
thought_leader.key_insight: Traditional design focuses on 'user flows' (humans doing tasks). The new paradigm is 'AI orchestration' (humans directing AI to do tasks).
thought_leader.implication: Evaluate how well humans can direct, monitor, and intervene in AI task execution

paradigm_shift.from: User flows - Human does task, UI facilitates
paradigm_shift.to: Orchestration flows - AI does task, human directs and monitors

orchestration_dimensions.name: Delegation Clarity
orchestration_dimensions.description: Can humans clearly delegate tasks to AI?

questions: Is it clear what can be delegated vs. what cannot?
Can users express delegation with appropriate constraints?
Is partial delegation supported (AI does steps 1-3, human does 4)?
Can delegation be revoked or modified mid-task?

anti_patterns.description: User must delegate entire task or do it all manually
anti_patterns.impact: Users avoid delegation for partially complex tasks

anti_patterns.description: User doesn't know what AI will do with delegation
User cannot limit AI's approach or boundaries
anti_patterns.impact: AI may do things user wouldn't want

anti_patterns.description: Once delegated, user cannot take back or modify

orchestration_dimensions.name: Progress Visibility
orchestration_dimensions.description: Can humans monitor AI task progress appropriately?

questions: Is AI progress visible at appropriate granularity?
Can users drill into detail when needed?
Are unexpected situations highlighted proactively?
Is progress honest (not fake progress bars)?
what_to_look_for: Progress indicators that reflect actual state

anti_patterns.description: No visibility into what AI is doing
Progress bar doesn't reflect reality
AI fails silently without notification
Too much detail obscures important info

orchestration_dimensions.name: Intervention Points
orchestration_dimensions.description: Can humans intervene effectively when needed?

questions: Are there clear points where humans can intervene?
Is intervention low-friction when urgently needed?
Can humans redirect without starting over?
Does intervention preserve AI context?
what_to_look_for: Graceful handoff from AI to human

anti_patterns.description: Once started, AI runs to completion
Stopping AI means losing all progress
anti_patterns.impact: Users hesitant to intervene even when needed

anti_patterns.description: Stopping AI is difficult or confusing
AI forgets what it was doing after intervention

intervention_types.use_case: Need time to evaluate before continuing

metrics.name: intervention_latency
metrics.description: Time from user decision to effective intervention

orchestration_dimensions.name: Outcome Verification
orchestration_dimensions.description: Can humans verify AI completed tasks correctly?

questions: Can users verify outcomes without redoing the work?
Is verification effort proportional to task risk?
Are verification tools appropriate to user expertise?
Can AI explain its approach to aid verification?
what_to_look_for: Deep verification options for high-stakes tasks
AI highlighting areas most likely to need human review

anti_patterns.description: Checking AI work takes as long as doing it manually
Same verification burden for all risk levels
anti_patterns.impact: Over-verification of routine, under-verification of critical

anti_patterns.description: Only specialists can verify AI output
AI can't explain how it arrived at output
anti_patterns.impact: User can't verify reasoning, only output

verification_levels.description: Detailed examination of reasoning and output

metrics.name: verification_efficiency
metrics.description: Verification time vs manual production time

orchestration_dimensions.name: Learning Loop
orchestration_dimensions.description: Do orchestration patterns improve over time?

questions: Does AI learn user's orchestration preferences?
Can users shape AI behavior through correction?
Is the learning transparent and controllable?
Does orchestration efficiency improve over time?
what_to_look_for: AI adapts to user's delegation style
User can see what AI has learned
Less direction needed over time for same outcomes

anti_patterns.description: Same patterns regardless of history
AI repeats same mistakes
AI changes behavior without explanation
Same effort required regardless of experience

metrics.name: orchestration_efficiency_trend
metrics.description: Effort required over time for similar tasks

metrics.name: correction_incorporation_rate
metrics.description: User corrections reflected in future behavior

steps.name: Map Orchestration Flow
actions: Identify what tasks user delegates to AI
